items.quote: Therefore Sarah laughed within herself, saying, After I am waxed old shall I have pleasure, my lord being old also?
items.claim: Sarah laughed to herself, expressing doubt about bearing a child in old age

items.quote: And the LORD said unto Abraham, Wherefore did Sarah laugh, saying, Shall I of a surety bear a child, which am old?
items.claim: The LORD spoke to Abraham, questioning why Sarah laughed about bearing a child in old age

items.quote: At the time appointed I will return unto thee, according to the time of life, and Sarah shall have a son.
items.claim: The LORD promised to return at the appointed time
